title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Lapse of Quotes, Cancellation of Covers and Premium Refunds
content:
A quote or a bound cover under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` can come to an end without a claim. This page covers the lapse of quotes, the cancellation of bound covers and the refund of premium that follows cancellation.

## Clauses

1. **Lapse of a quote.** A quote lapses, at no charge, when it has not been bound by the binding deadline or when the customer declines it. A quote that lapses or is declined takes the status cancelled on the cover record.
2. **Cancellation of a bound cover.** A bound cover may be cancelled at the cover holder's instruction, but only while the booking has not yet departed. Once the booking has departed the risk has attached, and cancellation is no longer possible.
3. **Statutory tier.** Being the statutory regime, `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` is not open to cancellation.
4. **Refund on cancellation.** Cancelling a cover returns to the holder the tier's refund percentage of the premium that was charged, the amount rounded to the cent, and the refund refers to the premium entry it concerns.
5. **Paid or unpaid alike.** The refund applies in the same way whether the premium has already been paid or is still due, because its effect is to reduce the premium owed.
6. **Status for a refund.** A refund of premium is recorded solely against a cover that stands cancelled.
7. **Once only.** Any one premium entry is refunded no more than once.

## Booking status and cancellation

The booking's status on the line's booking record decides clause 2.

| Booking status | Bound cover cancellable at the holder's instruction? |
|---|---|
| requested | yes |
| confirmed | yes |
| equipment released | yes |
| gated in | yes |
| loaded | yes |
| cancelled | yes |
| any status after departure | no |

## Refund percentages

| Tier | Share of premium charged that is refunded on cancellation (percent) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 100 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 100 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 100 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 90 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 90 |

## Worked example (hypothetical amounts)

A cover under `AHL CargoCare Premium` was charged a premium of 812.40 USD and is cancelled while its booking is loaded but has not departed. The refund is 90 percent of 812.40, which is 731.16 USD, booked against that premium entry. Had the same premium been charged under `AHL CargoCare Plus`, the whole 812.40 would be refunded. In either case it makes no difference whether the holder had paid the premium.
